items.html: And also what the Sages said, that in the days of Purim one gives to whoever stretches out his hand — the matter is that the charity collector (gabbai) is the Yesod; and on the weekdays, which is the Yesod of ZA, one must see to whom he gives the charity. But now, since it is the Yesod of Aba, a great illumination, there is no need to be particular; rather, one gives to whoever stretches out his hand.
